awaySeconds.title: Away for (seconds)
awaySeconds.description: A staff reply alerts the visitor when they have not checked the chat for this long; once until they check again.

channels.title: Channels, in order
channels.description: Pick them in the order to try. The alert goes by the first one the visitor has an address for (a phone for WhatsApp and SMS, an e-mail address for e-mail); when Notifications does not take it there (that channel is off or has no template), the next one is tried. None: no alerts.
